findings.title: Broad IAM administration or PassRole grant

evidence.assessment: escalation candidate, effective privilege not proven

findings.remediation: Restrict IAM actions and role ARNs, require iam:PassedToService for PassRole, and review boundaries, denies, and the caller's related service grants.

findings.title: AdministratorAccess is attached directly or through a group
findings.remediation: Replace AdministratorAccess with a scoped role; restrict privileged sessions with approval, MFA, and an appropriate permissions boundary.

findings.title: Active access key needs review
findings.remediation: Identify the key by suffix and fingerprint. Migrate to temporary role credentials; otherwise rotate with a tested overlap, deactivate, then delete the old key.

findings.title: Role trusts an external AWS principal
findings.remediation: Restrict trust to approved role ARNs. For delegated third-party access require a unique ExternalId with StringEquals; review other conditions and keep a trusted-account exception only with an owner and reason.

findings.title: Allow statement contains a global wildcard
findings.remediation: Replace global actions with required actions and scope resources where supported. Document actions requiring Resource '*' with a suppression.

findings.title: IAM user has no assigned MFA device
findings.remediation: Assign and enforce MFA for interactive access; migrate programmatic-only users to workload roles. An assigned device alone does not prove policy enforcement.

findings.title: User has no recent recorded activity
findings.remediation: Confirm ownership and seasonal use, remove unneeded permissions, and disable unused credentials or retire the role through a reviewed change.
